# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- THE FEED ON THE CITY SCREEN (Paolo 9/4/26, LOCKED)
# "when it's in zoomed out city mode, I do want part of the UI to show like a
# phone screen and then the social post just like scrolling whether it's our
# achievements or just like auto generated post... I really want that to be
# part of the UI when you zoom out in the city builder city view... the
# social feed in the world just scrolling and if you read it you'll be able
# to learn more about the world and then you'll see your quests that you've
# done."

## THE RULING
- **IN THE ZOOMED-OUT CITY VIEW, A PHONE SCREEN IS PART OF THE UI, AND IT
  SCROLLS A SOCIAL FEED.** Always on screen in that mode, somewhere he
  chooses by eye. Tab: CITY (the builder view, MODE==='city').
- **THREE KINDS OF POST, ONE STREAM:**
  1. **WHAT YOU DID.** Every finished quest and every deed the ledger
     already records ("THE VALLEY'S MEMORY OF WHAT YOU DID TO IT" writes
     a move with its reason) becomes a post. Your achievements, in the
     world's mouth.
  2. **WHAT THE WORLD DID.** Faction events, territory changes, a town
     going dark, a crisis building (day 11's foretold escalation), the man
     who lived telling people (day 12).
  3. **AUTO-GENERATED LIFE.** Ambient posts from people in the valley,
     keyed off what exists (day 13's combinations: trade, circuit owner,
     hour, what you are known for), so the valley reads as alive when
     nothing is happening (day 22's finding, in text).
- **READING IT TEACHES THE WORLD.** It is the map's caption. A stranger
  who reads the feed for a minute knows who holds what, who is at war,
  what things cost, and what he has done. This is the phone's second job:
  the first was the job offer (8/12); this is the world talking.
- **REUSE-FIRST:** the phone panel exists (phonewrap, phoneslot,
  phonePush); the deed ledger exists; faction events exist behind the
  loop (day 6). No new memory: the feed READS what the game already
  writes. Posts are text, so ALWAYS MAKE AN ATTEMPT (8/11) applies: real
  attempts, draft:true, edited in WORDS later.
- **120 BPM:** a post lands on a beat; the scroll moves on the beat.
- **WHO POSTS AND WHAT THEY SAY** is words (attempt) and world (his where
  it is canon: which faction says what about whom).

## ROUTING
- UI: THE-FEED-ON-THE-CITY-SCREEN (the surface, in CITY mode).
- WORLD / PEOPLE: THE-FEED-STREAM (the three sources as one event stream
  the surface reads; the ledger first because it exists).
- WORDS (research mode): a question on how a feed talks, so the posts do
  not sound like a press release.
- Gate: a feed gate asserts a finished quest appears in the feed within
  a beat and the feed is present in CITY mode in the demo.
